fluency.title: At the Park
fluency.text: Sam and Mia ran to the park. They sat on a red bench. A dog ran past. Sam said, "Look at that dog!" Mia smiled and waved.

fluency.title: Rain Day
fluency.text: The rain fell on the boat. Tess had a green coat. She read a book inside. Then the sun came out.

fluency.title: The Little Train
fluency.text: The little train went up the hill. It did not stop. Kids waved from the seats. The train made a soft sound.

comprehension.passage: Nina has a small fish. The fish is blue. Nina feeds the fish every day. The fish swims fast.
comprehension.question: What color is the fish?

comprehension.passage: Omar packed a bag for a picnic. He put in bread, apples, and juice. Then he checked the map.
comprehension.question: Why did Omar check the map?

comprehension.passage: A fox hid behind a tree. A hen walked by. The fox stayed still and quiet.
comprehension.question: Why did the fox stay still?
options: so the hen would not see it
comprehension.answer: so the hen would not see it
